title: DeYoung House

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Meet the people, explore the places, and discover the stories behind the community through photographs, artifacts, maps, and local treasures. Woodinville’s past is closer-and more surprising-than you think. Discover the story of the DeYoung family and a century of Woodinville history. Beginning with John and Ellen DeYoung’s arrival in Woodinville in 1925, this new exhibit follows a family whose hard work, gumption, and commitment to community helped shape the town around them. Celebrate the story of Molbak’s and its lasting place in Woodinville’s community memory. Through photographs, artifacts, and shared stories, visitors can remember the sights, colors, and experiences that made Molbak’s
